items.source: A subclass of BeanCreationException which indicates that the target scope is not active, for example, in case of request or session scope.
items.translation: BeanCreationException 的子类，表示目标作用域未激活，例如在请求或会话作用域的情况下。

items.source: Uses of BeanCreationException in org.springframework.beans.factory
items.translation: `org.springframework.beans.factory` 包中 `BeanCreationException` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanCreationException in org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation
Uses of BeanCreationException in org.springframework.beans.factory.support
items.translation: `org.springframework.beans.factory.support` 包中 `BeanCreationException` 的用法

items.source: Uses of BeanCreationException in org.springframework.context.annotation
items.translation: `org.springframework.context.annotation` 中 `BeanCreationException` 的用法

items.source: Native processing method for direct calls with an arbitrary target instance, resolving all of its fields and methods which are annotated with one of the configured 'autowired' annotation types.
items.translation: 原生 处理方法，用于直接调用具有任意目标实例的情况，解析所有使用配置的某个'autowired'注解类型之一进行注解的字段和方法。

items.source: Native processing method for direct calls with an arbitrary target instance, resolving all of its fields and methods which are annotated with one of the supported 'resource' annotation types.
items.translation: 原生 处理方法，用于直接调用具有任意目标实例的情况，解析所有使用一个或多个支持的“资源”注解类型标注的字段和方法。

items.source: The core package implementing Spring's lightweight Inversion of Control (IoC) container.
items.translation: 实现 Spring 轻量级控制反转（IoC）容器的核心包。

items.source: Support package for annotation-driven bean configuration.
items.translation: 用于注解驱动的 Bean 配置的辅助包。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source:
Exception thrown in case of a bean being requested despite
bean creation currently not being allowed (for example, during
the shutdown phase of a bean factory).
items.translation: 在请求 Bean 但当前不允许创建 Bean 的情况下抛出异常（例如，在 BeanFactory 的关闭阶段）。

items.source: Exception thrown in case of a reference to a bean that's currently in creation.
items.translation: 在引用当前正在创建的 Bean 时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean instance has been requested for
a bean definition which has been marked as abstract.
items.translation: 当请求一个被标记为抽象的 Bean 定义的 Bean 实例时抛出异常。

items.source:
Exception thrown when a bean depends on other beans or simple properties
that were not specified in the bean factory definition, although
dependency checking was enabled.
items.translation: 当 Bean 依赖于未在 Bean 工厂定义中指定的其他 Bean 或简单属性，且启用了依赖检查时抛出异常。

items.source:
Central method of this class: creates a bean instance,
populates the bean instance, applies post-processors, etc.
items.translation: 本类的核心方法：创建 Bean 实例，填充 Bean 实例，应用后置处理器等。

items.source: Create a bean instance for the given merged bean definition (and arguments).
items.translation: 为给定的合并后的 Bean 定义（和参数）创建 Bean 实例。
